summary: Synchrony Card Funding, LLC filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for a $750,000,000 tranche of SynchronySeries Class A(2026-3) asset-backed notes issued by Synchrony Card Issuance Trust, backed by revolving credit card receivables originated by Synchrony Bank. Notes carry a 5.13% coupon, priced at 99.98413% to public, with 0.25% underwriting discount, expected issuance November 16, 2026, monthly interest from December 15, 2026, scheduled principal November 2029 and legal maturity November 2032. Credit enhancement is subordinated notes plus subordinated transferor amount; joint bookrunners BofA Securities and Barclays. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
